answer: Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone burns for every seat it wants. The pulse register is checked at draw time, ripple lists the eligible set, and quartz seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 81 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 117 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
